question: Which team won the 2022 Durand Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru Football Club**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **131st edition** of the Durand Cup kickstarted on August 16, 2022, at the Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata.
 
• The final was played on September 18 at the **Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata**.
 
• **Bengaluru FC beat Mumbai City 2-1** to claim a memorable maiden Durand Cup win.
 
• It was the **first-ever Durand Cup win for Sunil Chhetri and Bengaluru FC**.
 
• 20 teams are part of this edition of the competition (11 ISL teams, five I-League teams, and four teams from the Indian Armed Forces).
 
• It is the oldest football competition in Asia, having been launched in 1888.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Football trophies are**:-

 
 
• I-League
 
• Indian Super League trophy
 
• Federation Cup
 
• Santosh Trophy
 
• Subroto Cup
 
• IFA Shield
 
• Rovers Cup
